messages:
sara_p: Quick sync: need to finalize the catalog stability + rollback criteria for new model onboarding and retirements. Meeting Wed, but jotting down thoughts here.

mike_l: Thanks — can you list proposed numeric thresholds? latency/regression/failed requests etc.

sara_p: Proposed: perf benchmark vs baseline: 95th latency <= baseline + 15%, 99th <= baseline + 30%. Quality: top-level eval suite must not drop >2% accuracy/emd or 1.5 pts for our rubric. Error rate: tail errors <0.5%.

jonah_m: For evals, we need sample sizes per workload. Suggest at least 500 samples per vertical, 1k for search/agents. Also A/B with exposed traffic >=5% for 48h.

ali_s: Support requested clarity on pinning. Customers ask for 'pin to model X' until migration. We need explicit auto-deprecation notice windows.

sara_p: Pinning policy: allow customer pin for up to 90 days. After that, we send auto-reminder and offer migration assistance. For infra reasons, team can enforce 180-day hard sunset with 30-day notice.

mike_l: Rollback criteria: if regression observed in canary (user-visible metric) exceeds threshold (3% drop) OR error rate >1% OR latency 95th > baseline+50% -> automatic rollback. Need a runbook.

jonah_m: Rollout plan: staged 0->1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Wait at least 2x evaluation windows at each stage (24h baseline) and validate eval suite and telemetry. If borderline, escalate.

sara_p: Launch checklist (short): model VERIFIED in catalog, quantization profile attached, bench reports uploaded, pin/migration policy set, rollout plan and fallback route configured, docs updated, support oncall tagged.

mike_l: Action items: @jonah_m generate eval matrix template, @ali_s draft user-facing pinning notice and migration FAQ, @mike_l and @sara_p produce rollback runbook. I can template the alerts for latency & errors.

jonah_m: :thumbsup: I'll attach the template to the thread before EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary job created: job_id=cb-1781, checks=[latency,errors,eval-diff].

ali_s: One more ask: for enterprise customers, we'd like longer pin windows + opt-in migration windows. Should we gate that behind Dedicated/Private?

sara_p: Yes — propose enterprise pin extension by contract up to 12 months. Note we still require security patches; ops will enforce critical updates.

mike_l: Noted. We'll add a line in the runbook: 'critical security fixes override pinning; customers notified 30d in advance'.

sara_p: :eyes: Great. I'll collect and convert to the formal PRD and circulate. Meeting Wed 10am to sign off.
